b1-11-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Our Neighbourhood
b1-11-01.scenario: You are Meg. You are on the phone with Carlos's grandmother in Madrid. She asks what your neighbourhood in Budapest is like.
b1-11-01.prompt: Tell her about the neighbourhood and your street.
b1-11-01.target: Vivimos en un barrio que tiene una plaza tranquila. La calle donde vivimos está cerca de una estación.
b1-11-01.english: We live in a neighbourhood that has a quiet square. The street where we live is near a station.
b1-11-01.canDo: I can describe my neighbourhood using relative clauses and location language.

b1-11-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Changing Area
b1-11-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks about the area of Madrid where your grandmother lives. You remember that there used to be less traffic, but the area has grown.
b1-11-02.prompt: Tell Meg how the area was before and how it has changed.
cues: Say what there used to be
Say what has changed since then
b1-11-02.target: Antes había menos tráfico, pero el barrio ha crecido mucho y, desde entonces, hay más servicios.
b1-11-02.english: There used to be less traffic, but the neighbourhood has grown a lot and, since then, there are more services.
b1-11-02.canDo: I can describe how a city or neighbourhood has changed.

b1-11-03.title: Communicative Challenge: City Problems
b1-11-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos talk about the problems of your area in Budapest: too many cars, so more pollution.
b1-11-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what the problem is and what it causes.
b1-11-03.target: Hay demasiados coches, por eso hay más contaminación y mucho ruido.
b1-11-03.english: There are too many cars, so there is more pollution and a lot of noise.
b1-11-03.canDo: I can describe common urban problems.

b1-11-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What Should the Council Do?
b1-11-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what the city council should do for pedestrians in your area.
b1-11-04.prompt: Recommend what the council should do and why.
b1-11-04.target: Recomiendo que el ayuntamiento mejore las aceras para que los peatones puedan caminar con seguridad.
b1-11-04.english: I recommend that the city council improve the pavements so that pedestrians can walk safely.
b1-11-04.canDo: I can make recommendations for improving a city.

b1-11-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Coketown and Our Meeting
b1-11-05.scenario: You are Meg. You have read about Coketown, the smoky factory town in Dickens's novel, and you take part in a neighbourhood meeting with Carlos. Tell him what the town was like and what you propose.
b1-11-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what Coketown was like and make a proposal.
b1-11-05.target: Coketown era una ciudad con mucho humo y calles todas iguales. Propongo que haya más parques para las personas.
b1-11-05.english: Coketown was a town with a lot of smoke and streets that were all the same. I propose that there be more parks for people.
b1-11-05.canDo: I can participate in a community discussion.

b1-11-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Better Area
b1-11-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what you would do to improve your area in Budapest.
b1-11-consolidation.prompt: Say what is necessary and make a proposal.
cues: Say what the council needs to do
b1-11-consolidation.target: Es necesario que el ayuntamiento reduzca el tráfico, por eso propongo que construyamos un parque.
b1-11-consolidation.english: It is necessary for the council to reduce traffic, so I propose that we build a park.
b1-11-consolidation.canDo: I can consolidate city and neighbourhood language.
